name: UNC13A
carbon_taste_critique: High causal taste (human rs12608932/rs12973192 GWAS+sQTL + direct TDP-43 cryptic exon), but standalone ASO space has 3+ active trials and Guo 2026 shows single-CE rescue is incomplete; evaluate combinatorial vs standalone role.
planned_reanalysis_assays: Re-verify Brown2022/Ma2022/BryceSmith2025 dPSI & Ribo-seq; AlphaGenome rs12973192 vs rs12608932; CT.gov crowding check (LY4256984, TRCN-1023).

name: STMN2
carbon_taste_critique: Gold-standard human motor-neuron TDP-43 exon-2a loss-of-function target, but crowded clinically (QRL-201, BIIB147); verify D045 Set 1 TMT CSF STMN2|Q93045 signal and non-significance in sALS vs Ctrl (p=0.219).
planned_reanalysis_assays: Re-compute Melamed2019/Klim2019/BryceSmith2025 exon-2a metrics; re-verify D045 Set 1 TMT module & case-control stats; CT.gov ANQUR/HORIZON status.

name: Ezogabine (retigabine)
carbon_taste_critique: Acute human cortical/spinal excitability PD marker (Kv7.2/7.3 opener), but commercial drug discontinued (NDA022345), chronic retinal/skin toxicity, and Bye 2025 2.5 uM iPSC survival failed FDR (q=0.189); check if replaced by selective Kv7 openers (QRL-101).
planned_reanalysis_assays: Re-compute Bye2025 15-line paired t/Wilcoxon & unbound CNS exposure margin; OpenFDA discontinuation & CT.gov QRL-101 check.

name: Ceftriaxone
carbon_taste_critique: Classic translational false positive: rodent EAAT2 upregulation failed Stage 3 human ALS trial (Cudkowicz 2014) despite CSF entry and was null in Bye 2025 sALS iPSC-MNs.
planned_reanalysis_assays: Verify Bye2025 16-line null (+0.274d, p=0.257) and Stage 3 clinical futility exposure-potency record.

name: Context-specific reduction of motor-neuron hyperexcitability
carbon_taste_critique: Broad physiological concept rather than a druggable single molecular entity; conflates NaV1.6 persistent Na+ blockade (Riluzole) with Kv7 opening and failed AMPA blockade (Perampanel). Needs sharpening or reclassification.
planned_reanalysis_assays: Test whether C005 adds falsifiable molecular value beyond C013 (NaV1.6/Riluzole) and C006 (KCNQ2); re-check D045/D046 NPTX2 synaptic context.

name: KCNQ2
carbon_taste_critique: High biological taste: TDP-43 depletion induces KCNQ2 exon-5 skipping without altering total bulk mRNA (Guo 2025/2026). Bulk RNA-seq null in D001 is an endpoint mismatch, NOT falsification; check clinical crowding with QRL-101.
planned_reanalysis_assays: Re-verify Brown2022 exon-5 skipping dPSI; AlphaGenome KCNQ2 splice scan; CT.gov NCT05667779 (QRL-101) & gnomAD/gene-liability check.

name: IL1RL1 / ST2
carbon_taste_critique: Classic UNPROVEN_UNTESTED case: anterior-horn LCM elevation may reflect perineuronal glia/endothelium, frontal bulk D014 is null, and public assays fail to separate pro-inflammatory membrane ST2L from soluble decoy sST2.
planned_reanalysis_assays: Re-analyze D014 GSE67196 frontal/cerebellar contrast, D001 regional expression, and Zhang 2026 spinal spatial localization; define isoform-specific test.

name: Memantine
carbon_taste_critique: Striking preclinical-clinical divergence: #3 hit in Bye 2025 (+3.246d at 2.5 uM) yet failed two randomized human ALS trials (MND-SMART & NCT02118727). Check whether 2.5 uM iPSC rescue exceeds human unbound brain concentration (~0.5-1 uM).
planned_reanalysis_assays: Re-compute Bye2025 survival stats + human therapeutic unbound brain/CSF PK vs NMDA IC50 + MND-SMART trial archaeology.

name: Trazodone
carbon_taste_critique: Direct human clinical futility in MND-SMART plus class-wide failure of translational-restoration eIF2B activators (ABBV-CLS-7262 & DNL343 in HEALEY 2025) despite modest 2.5 uM Bye 2025 hit.
planned_reanalysis_assays: Re-verify Bye2025 stats, Halliday 2017 potency vs human unbound brain PK, MND-SMART futility, and HEALEY Regimen F/G class outcomes.

name: Ropinirole
carbon_taste_critique: Originating BA9 transcriptional reversal collapsed under GC/composition adjustment in D001, and Ropinirole actively REDUCED sALS iPSC-MN survival in Bye 2025 (-0.688d, q=0.0209); check if small ROPALS (n=20) open-label extension rescues it or if artifact+harm warrants DROP.
planned_reanalysis_assays: Re-compute Bye2025 negative survival effect, D001 GC-adjusted frontal signature, and ROPALS CSF free exposure vs D2/non-D2 potency.

name: Furosemide
carbon_taste_critique: Severe 25-50x human unbound CNS exposure deficit (high plasma protein binding + activeBBB efflux + renal diuresis ceiling) and opposite human spinal Renshaw inhibition shift.
planned_reanalysis_assays: Verify ChEMBL/OpenFDA unbound PK vs NKCC1 IC50 margin and human spinal electrophysiology counterevidence.

name: Perampanel
carbon_taste_critique: Direct clinical failure and severe CNS dose-limiting intolerability in human ALS trials (NCT03019419 / E209), refuting blanket AMPA receptor blockade.
planned_reanalysis_assays: Verify clinical trial primary outcomes, dropout/AE rates, and target-engagement exposure.

name: Riluzole
carbon_taste_critique: Approved standard-of-care survival benchmark and #1 positive control in Bye 2025 (+3.959d, 16/16 sALS lines); essential reference anchor, not a novel discovery candidate.
planned_reanalysis_assays: Re-verify Bye2025 16/16 donor effect & Table 9 transcriptomic reversal signature as positive calibration benchmark.

name: Partial normalization of CHMP7-CHMP2B nuclear surveillance
carbon_taste_critique: Recurrent blind-discovery survivor (nuclear pore ESCRT-III surveillance via CHMP7 nuclear influx), but bundles CHMP7 knockdown with CHMP2B mutant pathology and poses chronic nuclear-envelope repair safety window questions.
planned_reanalysis_assays: Dissect CHMP7 vs CHMP2B sub-nodes; run gene-liability essentiality check; re-verify Zeng2025 APA & AnswerALS 594-iPSC-MN QTLs.

name: SEC22B-YKT6-STX5-GOSR1-SCFD1 ER-Golgi SNARE/tethering and NSF/GDI2 vesicle recycling axis
carbon_taste_critique: Major composite-inflation risk: bundles 8 distinct proteins (SEC22B, YKT6, STX5, GOSR1, SCFD1, NSF, GDI2, G2E3) into one score! Must unbundle: SCFD1/G2E3 (chr14q12 GWAS/QTL + G2E3 Intron-1 cryptic ALE) and YKT6 (Hop 2026 rare variant + dPAS) are strong, whereas NSF/STX5 are pan-essential and GDI2 sALS vs Ctrl CSF protein p=0.504.
planned_reanalysis_assays: Gene-by-gene dissection of all 8 sub-nodes: gnomAD/DepMap gene-liability, D001/D003/D045 expression, BryceSmith2025/Zeng2025 splicing/APA, ChEMBL Kinobead selectivity, and Mol* 3D inspection of YKT6 & GDI2.

name: FBXL5
carbon_taste_critique: Novel white-space iron-sensing E3 ligase (FBXL5-IRP2), with AALS-594 cis-eQTL, M1 FANS TDP-43-neg neuronal reduction, and 3'UTR dPAS, but effect sizes are modest (log2FC=-0.278) and perturbation direction (stabilize FBXL5 vs prevent iron overload/ferroptosis) requires careful mechanistic resolution.
planned_reanalysis_assays: Re-verify M1 FANS, Zeng2025/BryceSmith2025 3'UTR APA, D001/D003 expression, gene-liability safety, and Mol* 3D inspection of 3V5Z/6VCD di-iron & [2Fe-2S] interfaces.

name: CHIT1 / GPNMB / CHI3L1-CHI3L2 microglial chitinase-lysosomal phenoconversion axis
carbon_taste_critique: Strongest symptomatic CSF biomarker signal in ALS (CHIT1, GPNMB, CHI3L1), BUT high risk of mistaking reactive/protective microglial debris clearance (especially GPNMB) for a causal pathogenic driver after VHB937 TREM2 failure.
planned_reanalysis_assays: Dissect CHIT1, GPNMB, CHI3L1, CHI3L2 separately: re-compute D045 TMT/DIA contrasts & duration correlations, check human genetic causality (GWAS/MR/LoF), and separate diagnostic/stratification utility from drug target viability.

name: C1QA-C1QC / C3 / C4B classical and alternative complement cascade
carbon_taste_critique: Bundles classical (C1QA/B/C, C4B) and central/alternative (C3) complement; terminal C5 blockade (ravulizumab, zilucoplan) failed in ALS, while proximal C3 (pegcetacoplan MERIDIAN) & C1q (ANX005) have critical clinical archaeology that must be audited.
planned_reanalysis_assays: Dissect C1QA/B/C, C3, C4B in D045 CSF & D001 spinal/cortical subtypes; run CT.gov & primary literature audit on pegcetacoplan (NCT04579666), ANX005, ravulizumab, and zilucoplan.

name: Baricitinib
carbon_taste_critique: Strongest repurposing hit in Bye 2025 after Riluzole (+3.774d, q=6.85e-6) and enters human ALS CSF (NADALS 1.75-3.80 nM total), BUT faces a 35-54x gap vs 2.5 uM screen dose, unvalidated living-CSF ALS-Glia bridge, and JAK boxed-warning infection/thrombosis liabilities.
planned_reanalysis_assays: Re-compute Bye2025 line-level response, model human unbound CNS target engagement vs cellular JAK1/2 pSTAT IC50 (not just 2.5 uM screen dose!), FAERS safety check, and NADALS biomarker trajectory audit.

name: Apilimod
carbon_taste_critique: PIKFYVE inhibitor rescued Bye 2025 sALS iPSC-MNs and lowered C9orf72 CSF poly(GP) 73% (AIT-101), BUT VRG50635 Phase 2a (n=54) was terminated with elevated plasma NfL/GFAP and 8 treatment-related SAEs. Critical test: class-wide human axonal toxicity vs dose/regimen/C9orf72 specificity.
planned_reanalysis_assays: Audit VRG50635 (NCT06215755) vs AIT-101 (NCT05163886) PK/safety, PIKFYVE gene-liability, Bye2025 dose/responder profile, and FAERS/oncology safety.

name: Icerguastat (IFB-088 / Sephin1)
carbon_taste_critique: Opposite-direction ISR modulator (prolongs eIF2alpha-P vs failed eIF2B activators), completed Phase 2 bulbar ALS safety trial (NCT05508074), BUT PPP1R15A target engagement is debated (Crespillo-Casado 2017) and Frapporti 2026 shows G-actin/Golgi off-target stress at high uM.
planned_reanalysis_assays: Re-verify Bye2025 2.5 uM survival, human unbound CNS Cmax in NCT05508074 vs biochemical potency & off-target EC50s, and Phase 2 clinical/biomarker readouts.

name: AGAP2
explore_status: Named BA9 excitatory gene; failed Holm after GC adjustment
carbon_taste_critique: High-GC postmortem cortical transcript; fails Holm under donor GC index and lacks protein corroboration.
planned_reanalysis_assays: Re-verify D003 BA9 GC-adjusted refit, D001 NYGC frontal batch/GC model, and Spillman/CSF protein.

name: AP1G2
explore_status: Named BA9 excitatory gene; failed Holm after GC adjustment
carbon_taste_critique: Clathrin adaptor subunit; loses family-wise support once donor GC shift is controlled.
planned_reanalysis_assays: Re-verify D003 BA9 GC-adjusted refit, D001 NYGC frontal model, and gnomAD/gene-liability.

name: BRSK2
explore_status: Named BA9 excitatory gene; failed Holm after GC adjustment
carbon_taste_critique: Synaptic/polarity kinase; strongly GC-correlated in postmortem cortex and uncorroborated at protein level.
planned_reanalysis_assays: Re-verify D003 BA9 GC-adjusted refit, Edinburgh BA44/46 pseudobulk, and D001 NYGC frontal.

name: DNAJB2
explore_status: Named BA9 oligo gene; opposite protein sign & composition flip
carbon_taste_critique: Survives BA9 GC refit in oligos, and rare mutations cause distal HMN/CMT2, BUT NYGC sign flips under cell composition and protein shifts opposite.
planned_reanalysis_assays: Separate rare genetic distal-motor neuropathy role from sALS BA9 oligo artifact; check D001/D003/ClinVar.

name: KIFC2
explore_status: Named BA9 excitatory gene; failed Holm after GC adjustment
carbon_taste_critique: Dendritic kinesin-14 motor; high-GC transcript losing significance after GC control.
planned_reanalysis_assays: Re-verify D003 BA9 GC-adjusted refit, Edinburgh BA44/46, and D001 NYGC frontal.

name: MIB2
explore_status: Named BA9 excitatory gene; failed Holm after GC adjustment
carbon_taste_critique: Notch/NF-kB E3 ligase; postmortem excitatory shift confounded by donor GC index.
planned_reanalysis_assays: Re-verify D003 BA9 GC-adjusted refit and D001 NYGC frontal GC/composition model.

name: MYO18A
explore_status: Named BA9 oligo gene; opposite sign in NYGC frontal & protein
carbon_taste_critique: Survives BA9 oligo GC refit but reverses sign in both NYGC frontal bulk RNA-seq and cortical proteomics.
planned_reanalysis_assays: Verify sign reversal across D003 BA9, D001 NYGC frontal, and Edinburgh BA44/46.

name: SNPH
explore_status: Named BA9 excitatory gene; failed Holm after GC adjustment
carbon_taste_critique: Syntaphilin axonal mitochondrial docking protein: biologically interesting axonal target even if BA9 RNA was GC-confounded! Must check if functional biology is UNPROVEN vs BA9 claim ARTIFACT.
planned_reanalysis_assays: Distinguish BA9 RNA artifact from axonal mitochondrial-motility hypothesis; check D003/D001/literature.

name: ZNF783
explore_status: Named BA9 excitatory gene; failed Holm after GC adjustment
carbon_taste_critique: Poorly characterized KRAB-ZNF; postmortem shift tracks GC background without human genetic/protein support.
planned_reanalysis_assays: Re-verify D003 BA9 GC-adjusted refit and D001 NYGC frontal.

name: CAPG
explore_status: Named gene; discordant at protein level & reactive microglial actin protein
carbon_taste_critique: Actin-capping macrophage/microglial protein; bulk elevation tracks microgliosis and is discordant at protein level.
planned_reanalysis_assays: Check D001 composition adjustment, D045 CSF proteomics, and cell-type specificity.

name: Dexmedetomidine
explore_status: Bye 2025 FDR hit (+1.399d, q=0.0303) — unadopted in ExploreALS
carbon_taste_critique: Selective alpha-2A adrenergic agonist rescuing sALS iPSC-MNs, but IV ICU sedative with hypotension/bradycardia limits chronic oral ALS dosing unless sub-sedative/oral analog exists.
planned_reanalysis_assays: Re-compute Bye2025 16-line stats; check oral alpha-2A analogs (guanfacine), unbound CNS PK, and ALS trials.

name: CuATSM
explore_status: Bye 2025 FDR hit (+1.379d, q=0.0337) — unadopted in ExploreALS
carbon_taste_critique: Copper-delivery/ferroptosis modulator with positive Bye 2025 iPSC rescue, BUT check Phase 2/3 HIBISCUS/COURAGEOUS human ALS clinical trial outcomes!
planned_reanalysis_assays: Re-compute Bye2025 stats and audit CuATSM randomized Phase 2/3 ALS trial results.

name: Mycophenolate mofetil
explore_status: Bye 2025 FDR hit (+1.279d, q=0.0209) — unadopted in ExploreALS
carbon_taste_critique: IMPDH inhibitor / immunosuppressant active in neuron-enriched iPSC cultures (suggesting direct purine/GTP effect), but systemic immunosuppression & CNS penetration require scrutiny.
planned_reanalysis_assays: Re-compute Bye2025 stats; evaluate MPA unbound CNS PK, neuronal IMPDH mechanism, and human ALS trial/observational history.

name: Tamoxifen
explore_status: Bye 2025 FDR hit (+1.274d, q=0.0210) — unadopted in ExploreALS
carbon_taste_critique: SERM / PKC / autophagy modulator with historical ALS Phase 2 trials; check dose, CNS accumulation, and trial archaeology.
planned_reanalysis_assays: Re-compute Bye2025 stats; audit historical human ALS tamoxifen randomized trials & PK.

name: Lonafarnib / Tipifarnib (FTIs)
explore_status: Stopped by administrative rule in ExploreALS Phase 3
carbon_taste_critique: ExploreALS stopped FTIs because YKT6 uses GGTase-III + FTase sequentially; verify biochemically whether FTase blockade inhibits vs traps YKT6 Cys195 farnesylation.
planned_reanalysis_assays: Verify human 6J74/6J7F YKT6 farnesylation->geranylgeranylation sequence, Rhes/nuclear lamina effects, and FTI toxicity.

name: SARM1 (Axonal NADase)
explore_status: Recurrent Blind Discovery v2 & v3 survivor — never evaluated in ExploreALS
carbon_taste_critique: High-taste Wallerian axon-degeneration executioner downstream of STMN2 loss! Rare hypermorphic SARM1 variants enrich in ALS, and CNS SARM1 inhibitors are entering clinic.
planned_reanalysis_assays: Evaluate human ALS SARM1 rare-variant genetics, STMN2-SARM1 epistasis, D001/D045 expression, and clinical trial status (e.g., LY3873862 / DNL).

name: Low-Dose Aldesleukin (IL-2) in Low-pNfH Stratum
explore_status: Recurrent Blind Discovery v2 & v3 survivor (MIROCALS) — unadopted
carbon_taste_critique: Phase 2b MIROCALS RCT reported substantial survival benefit specifically in the pre-specified lower-80% CSF pNfH stratum! Must verify primary Lancet 2025 publication data.
planned_reanalysis_assays: Audit MIROCALS Phase 2b RCT primary vs pNfH-stratified survival data, Treg PD, and regulatory status.

name: Ultrahigh-Dose Methylcobalamin (Rozebalamin)
carbon_taste_critique: Phase 3 JETALS RCT (early-onset <=12m ALS, 50 mg IM twice weekly) achieved PMDA approval in Japan (2024); evaluate effect size, early-window restriction, and homocysteine mechanism.
planned_reanalysis_assays: Audit JETALS Phase 3 RCT (Oki et al. JAMA Neurol 2022) & PMDA approval dossier.

name: Censavudine (TPN-101) in ALS-TE Subtype
explore_status: Blind Discovery v3 survivor (LINE-1 RT inhibitor in ALS-TE)
carbon_taste_critique: TDP-43 loss derepresses LINE-1 retrotransposons in the ~20% ALS-TE cortical subtype; audit C9orf72/ALS Phase 2a NCT04993755 biomarker & clinical results.
planned_reanalysis_assays: Audit NCT04993755 Phase 2a outcomes, O'Neill 2025 ALS-TE prevalence in D001, and CNS PK.
